name: cavemio-earnings-chart
title: Earnings chart
description: A bar chart that changes instead of redrawing: bars glide between periods, the scale and the total roll, a readout follows the pointer.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The period switch is a radio group (arrow keys move). The plot is one tab stop: arrow keys, Home and End move the readout between bars and it is announced politely; Escape hides it.
- Every bar’s figure is in a visually hidden table, with the total in its caption.
- Green and red are only used for the change, and always with an arrow that points the same way.
- Bars, lane and readout are divs moved by left, width and height on a dozen elements; nothing animates while it’s off screen.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion every change happens in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: periods
props.description: – · Each with id, label (for the switch), bars ({ key, label, value, title? }) and optionally previous (the total before, for the chip) and comparison.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: the last period · The period on show, by id; controlled or not.

props.name: format
props.description: USD, no decimals · How amounts read; the scale uses the same with compact notation.

props.name: highlight
props.description: the last bar · The bar drawn in your primary colour, by key.

features.title: Switch period, keep the bars
features.description: Months both periods share glide to their new place and height. Months that leave fold away and new ones grow in.

features.title: Totals that roll
features.description: The total and the scale labels roll to their new figures instead of changing at once.

features.title: A change chip
features.description: The change against the period before is emerald with an up arrow, or red with a down arrow. It folds away when there is nothing to compare.

features.title: A readout that follows the pointer
features.description: A thin line column and a readout ride from bar to bar. On touch, tap or drag across the bars.

features.title: Highlight the bar that matters
features.description: One bar is drawn in your primary colour, the last by default, or any bar by key.

features.title: Accessible by default
features.description: The period switch is a radio group, arrow keys move the readout, and every figure is in a visually hidden table.

states.title: arrive
states.description: In view for the first time, each bar grows from the baseline (640ms, 28ms apart) and the total rolls up from zero (1000ms).

states.title: period
states.description: The pill is thrown to the choice (460ms). Bars with the same key in both periods glide to their new place and width (560ms) and ease to their new height; bars that leave fold to nothing on the side they were on; new bars grow in. The scale labels, total and change roll.

states.title: hover
states.description: A thin line column glides to the bar under the pointer (380ms, slight overshoot), the other bars dim, and the readout at its top slides along with the month morphing and the amount rolling. On touch, tap or drag across the bars.

states.title: change
states.description: The change against the period before is a chip, emerald with an up arrow or red with the arrow turned down. A period with nothing to compare folds the chip away.
